pages.text: A product combining dark magic and machinery. Place it in a stress network to read all stress data of that network.$(br)Can be used together with the $(l:goetymech_machines/stress_ark)Stress Ark$(/l) and $(l:goetymech_machines/remote_engine)Remote Engine$(/l). When a Stress Ark is present, all stress data collected by Stress Readers will be aggregated to the ark.$(br)$(4)"Through it, we will transmit stress in a much lighter way."$()
